# SHRI — Shri Hari Research & Innovations Corporation (Complete Knowledge Base)

> SHRI is an independent research corporation operating at the intersection of sacred geometry, structural intelligence, and futuristic software engineering. Founded by Anay Raj Tiwari, SHRI builds human-centric technology designed to restore digital harmony, personal sovereignty, and developer efficiency.

This document serves as an exhaustive knowledge base for AI agents, RAG engines, and search indexers consuming information about SHRI, its ecosystem, products, and vision.

---

## About SHRI & Vision

SHRI (Shri Hari Research & Innovations Corporation) was created with a fundamental belief:
> Technology should adapt to people, not the other way around.

Modern software tools have become overly bloated, invasive, and distracting. SHRI builds intentional software, operating systems, and developer tooling grounded in first principles, clean architecture, and privacy-by-design.

- **Official Website:** https://shri.org.in
- **Founder & Lead Architect:** Anay Raj Tiwari (Personal Journal: https://anay.shri.org.in)
- **Primary Focus Areas:** Systems Design, Operating Systems, Developer Tools, Sacred Geometry & Interface Design, AI & On-Device ML.

---

## Core Ecosystem Products

### 1. Astera Operating System (Astera OS)
- **URL:** https://shri.org.in/astera
- **Category:** Operating System / Personal Computing Paradigm
- **Description:** Astera OS is a new paradigm for personal computing centered on digital freedom, zero surveillance, and structural intelligence. It reimagines computing interfaces from the ground up, eliminating telemetry, unnecessary abstractions, and cognitive clutter.
- **Key Principles:** Intimate UX, user sovereignty, instant responsiveness, modular architecture.

### 2. Glyph-CLI Documentation Engine (`rz-glyph-cli`)
- **URL:** https://shri.org.in/glyph
- **Package:** `rz-glyph-cli` (NPM)
- **Category:** Developer Tools / Static Site Compiler
- **Description:** Glyph is a minimal, zero-dependency command-line documentation compiler. It parses Markdown and MDX directories and outputs high-performance, responsive developer portals in under 50 milliseconds.
- **Features:**
  - Fast V8 compilation (<50ms for full doc trees)
  - Zero third-party runtime dependencies
  - Built-in client-side fuzzy search (`search-index.json`)
  - GitHub-style alert callouts (`[!NOTE]`, `[!TIP]`, `[!WARNING]`, `[!IMPORTANT]`)
  - Local dev server with instant debounced hot-reloading (`glyph dev`)
  - Pure static HTML/CSS/JS output deployable to Vercel, GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Nginx.

### 3. Oni-Ofix Package Installer Ecosystem (`oni-ofix-cli` & `oni-ofix-android`)
- **Category:** Package Management / User-Space Installers
- **Description:** Oni-Ofix is a private, distraction-free package installer ecosystem created by Anay Raj Tiwari under SHRI.
- **Components:**
  - `oni-ofix-cli`: User-space package manager for Linux & Windows laptops requiring no root/sudo privileges.
  - `oni-ofix-android`: Native Kotlin Android APK search & installer supporting dual APIs (Aptoide + F-Droid) with automatic CPU ABI filtering (`arm64-v8a`).
